List downloads for a given year and source

txs_list_downloads.Rd

Discovers data artifacts published for a particular TEA program year by parsing the public HTML download pages, including the SAS-broker download forms that serve the actual data files.

Usage

txs_list_downloads(year, source = c("tapr", "aeis", "peims"), refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

year

Integer ending year.

source

One of "tapr", "aeis", "peims".

refresh

If TRUE, ignore the on-disk meta cache and re-fetch.

Value

A tibble with columns source, year, school_year, level, data_type, dataset, file_format, label, method, url, params.

Details

For TAPR this returns:

  • data_type = "advanced": one row per level and dataset code (dataset, e.g. "REF", "STAAR1") served by TEA's SAS broker. These are the statewide data files (numerators, denominators, and rates).

  • data_type = "dictionary": the statewide variable-dictionary workbooks (TAPR_campus_2024.xlsx, ...). These describe variables; they do not contain data.

For AEIS this returns one row per level and dataset code served by the per-year AEIS CGI. SRC is not a downloadable-file program; see txs_get_src().

For PEIMS this returns one row per financial single-file download: level is "district" or "charter" and data_type is "actual" or "budget". See txs_get_peims_finance().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_list_downloads(2024, "tapr")
} # }
